advisory_findings.title: Marked-vertex omission in imported radial construction
advisory_findings.description: The auxiliary Q may make an original vertex interior, so composite radial boundary maps need not fix that vertex. This is not a theorem counterexample. The audit independently gives an explicit linear embedding of the first barycentric subdivision of the linear triangle complex, bypassing the marking issue and proving the OWR derived-complex convention directly.
advisory_findings.recommended_action: Preserve the independent self-contained d=3 subdivision supplement; do not assert standalone novelty for it.
